title: Strict base naturality of the enriched cone unstraightening
statement:
Use simplicial sets, internal functor simplicial sets and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], right fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], the coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ and $Q^\bullet\to\Delta^\bullet$ of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching], and the cone adjunction $L_S\dashv U_S$ and enriched projective presheaf category $\mathcal P_S$ of [lem-coef-cone-presheaf-adjunction]. All bases and diagrams are small in fixed universes enlarged as necessary. For a base $S$, present an object $X\to S$ by the presheaf on the category of simplices of $S$ whose value at $\sigma:\Delta^n\to S$ is the set $\{x\in X_n:p(x)=\sigma\}$, with restriction induced by simplex operators. Morphisms of the simplex category are monotone maps $\theta:[m]\to[n]$ with $\tau=\sigma\theta$. In this presentation pullback along $u:T\to S$ is precomposition by $\tau\mapsto u\tau$, also on all parameterized maps defining the slice mapping simplicial sets. Diagram restriction is $u^*F=F\circ\mathfrak C[u]^{\mathrm{op}}$.

Equip $U_S$ with its canonical simplicial enrichment: a parameterized enriched map $F\times K\to G$ is sent to the composite $U_SF\times K\to U_S(F\times K)\to U_SG$, where the first map uses $K\to\operatorname{Sing}_QK$ and the cone product identification $U_S(F\times K)\cong U_SF\times\operatorname{Sing}_QK$, with $(\operatorname{Sing}_QK)_n=\operatorname{Hom}(Q^n,K)$. The simplexwise cone formula defines, in the displayed presheaf presentations, an equality of simplicial enriched functors
$$u^*U_S=U_Tu^*.$$
These equalities include equality on parameterized maps, identities and composition, and are compatible by equality with identity base maps and composites of base maps. Restriction of diagrams and of slice simplicial categories is strictly functorial in the base. Diagram restriction preserves projectively fibrant objects and objectwise weak homotopy equivalences. Pullback preserves right fibrations and maps between them which are weak homotopy equivalences on every vertex fiber. No slice model structure, right-fibration classification, or quasicategory assumption on the bases is imposed.
